Historical live-action cinema, 13 seconds, 16:9. Continue the supplied first frame. Natural skin and subdued gray-brown materials. The same Li Yan sits at the same low desk at night, looking toward the observer. Keep the same warm oil lamp and dark window. His hands rest naturally by the desk. One continuous eye-level medium close-up.
The man on screen says in natural Mandarin: 「今日怪你误了粮，明日怪我办事不力。」
The man on screen says in natural Mandarin: 「换了你我，照旧征粮，照旧出兵。」
Natural cloth and room ambience. No music. No on-screen text.
